reviews.quote: Came in with three of my favorite old pair of glasses to get repaired and updated. They are Warby Parker frames and even Warby Parker wouldn’t touch them because of how worn out and they were. I went to optometric cafe and they did a perfect job—refurbished and combined parts from two of the extremely damaged frames to create a brand new pair. And they fixed the third pair/updated the prescription in those as well. Really really happy with all of it.
